$comment: Non-secret deploy manifest. The Cloudflare API token is NOT here — it lives in the gitignored token_file below (or $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN). Update account_id + domain once confirmed for The Portland Company.
deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:production
